comparison.objective: Position or fasten two snowboard bindings at prescribed stance locations and angles; candidate calibrates two switch endpoints.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part planar placement, angular alignment, and—in one version—multi-screw insertion/turning versus fine slide-sense-hold-retighten adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Bindings must meet stance, angle, flatness, and optional fastening criteria; candidate requires two ≤6 mm over-center sensing states retained after tightening.
comparison.reason: Generic alignment and fastening are shared, but the record does not test feedback-guided adjustment of a mounted component without losing registration. Candidate fastener and drift limits remain unspecified.
